source_file: bp AI Media Planner PRD (Mar 2026) - data dependencies
note: Canonical list of data sources for the bp Investment Communications planner, drawn from the PRD's data pipeline and integration scope. How-used fields describe how each source WOULD feed the deterministic engine once wired in; they are intended-use descriptions, not confirmations that a source is live. All digital channel data arrives via the7stars BigQuery - no direct bp platform API connections.

sources.name: Historical campaign performance (the7stars)
sources.how_used: Would replace the response-curve priors with bp's own campaign history: spend, impressions, completed views and engagement per channel and month, used to set each channel's starting share and saturation point.
sources.data_quality: Refreshed on the BigQuery schedule; channel-level granularity.

sources.name: Brand lift and attention studies
sources.how_used: Would calibrate CTV and Online Video response curves against measured recall and attention among GBE panels, rather than completed views alone.

sources.name: Channel attribution framework
sources.how_used: Innovation phase. Would apply per-channel KPIs - view-through and frequency for CTV and video, viewability for display, reach for Meta - to weight channels by their measured contribution.

sources.name: Delivery and engagement by day
sources.how_used: Would power mid-flight reallocation: actual viewable impressions, completed views and engagement against plan benchmarks, surfacing budget shifts for human approval.

sources.name: Historical bp media plans
sources.how_used: Would ground plan generation through the RAG pipeline, and let each new plan's channel mix be checked against what was approved and run in prior years.

sources.name: Historical Investment Communications briefs
sources.how_used: Would give the brief-hooks tagger a taxonomy of recurring bp priorities (results, AGM, conferences) drawn from real past briefs.

sources.name: Engagement targets
sources.how_used: Would set the plan's GBE engagement target and cost-per-engagement ceiling from a formal source rather than the uploaded budget file.

sources.name: IPSOS Global Influentials (IGI)
sources.how_used: Would provide third-party validated GBE audience sizing, channel preference benchmarks and media consumption data, and confirm GBE match quality for Meta and Online Video.
sources.data_quality: Delivered via S3; commercial terms via the7stars.

sources.name: Digital Twins personas
sources.how_used: Would let audience persona detail (investor, analyst, policymaker, C-suite) feed channel weighting and creative scoring.

sources.name: Applecart audience graph
sources.how_used: Would enrich GBE targeting with professional network signals for precision display and social audiences.

sources.name: BP Signal intelligence feed
sources.how_used: Would feed financial market signals, the policy event calendar, energy-sector news and competitor capital announcements into plan generation, so plans adjust as conditions change.

sources.name: bp financial calendar
sources.how_used: Would confirm results, AGM and strategy-update dates and quiet periods, replacing the illustrative dates in the demo calendar.

sources.name: the7stars BigQuery - CTV & Streaming
sources.how_used: Would feed live CTV delivery, completion and frequency data into that channel's benchmark and response curve.

sources.name: the7stars BigQuery - Programmatic Display
sources.how_used: Would feed live PMP and contextual display delivery, viewability and engagement into that channel's benchmark.

sources.name: the7stars BigQuery - Online Video
sources.how_used: Would feed live online video delivery and completion data into that channel's benchmark.

sources.name: the7stars BigQuery - Meta
sources.how_used: Would feed live Meta delivery, reach and engagement into that channel's benchmark and response curve.

sources.name: Financial publisher PMP deals
sources.how_used: Would supply deal terms, floor prices and available GBE inventory on financial publishers to cap Programmatic Display at real PMP supply.

sources.name: Premium CTV inventory packages
sources.how_used: Would supply financial news and broadcaster VOD package pricing and availability to calibrate the CTV saturation point.
